Saved names, coordinates, time zones, and preferences are stored on this device. Sunrise and sunset calculations run on the device. The app does not require an account. You can remove saved places from Places. Clearing app data or uninstalling removes local app data.

Location permission is used while the app is open for setup and travel prompts. When you use current location or open a saved current-location place without an area name, coordinates may be sent to the device’s geocoding provider to suggest the area. City searches may send your query to that provider. These lookups may need the internet. Travel checks use foreground location without geocoding. Manual coordinates and offline city suggestions work without location permission. Saved-place calculations run on the device.

Firebase usage analytics is enabled by default, with opt-out in Settings. When enabled, Firebase receives usage and device information, app-instance identifiers, and approximate city/region derived from your internet connection; this is not fully anonymous. Advertising features are disabled. Custom events exclude saved coordinates, place names, and mantra activity. The app does not collect birth dates or age categories. Event retention is 2 months and user-data retention is 14 months, with reset on new activity off; aggregated reports may remain longer. Opting out stops future collection and does not delete data already received.

Timetable export and sharing happen only when you request them. An exported file includes the selected place, its coordinates, time zone, dates, and event times. The destination app or storage service handles what you share according to its own policies. Music plays locally from bundled tracks or a file you choose. Device files are chosen through Android’s picker; the app keeps their references on this device and does not upload audio or log practice sessions. A cloud file provider may need connectivity. Removing the music selection releases the app’s access to that file.
